issue.title: v2 dependency-id path codec for paths the current encoder cannot represent (ADJ-9)

task_type_fields.proposal:
Design and ship a v2 dependency-id path codec so notes whose vault paths cannot be encoded by the current `note__path__blockid` encoder (`dependency_id`, now in bob-cli `src/native/task_dependencies/mod.rs`, mirrored as `tryDependencyId` in bob-plugins) — for example paths with spaces or dots — can be dependency targets without a pre-existing `[id::]`. Today the Depends on stage shows such targets disabled ("path can't be an id") and the hooks/writers refuse them (ADJ-9; docs/task-dependencies.md §3).

Scope would cover: the new encoding and its decode/collision rules, all four implementations (Rust hooks, nav, the migration script, any ledger-tools lookup), conformance vectors in docs/task-dependencies.md, and a dry-run-first migration for existing ids if the format changes.

Proposed by bob-cli-3n.11 (publish phase, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #4); the epic plan defers the path codec under "Deliberately not doing" (ADJ-9: "No active note is affected today").
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-3n's plan (ADJ-9) deliberately deferred a new codec because no active note needed one; the shipped contract handles unencodable paths by refusing them with a visible reason. It should be built only when a real note needs it.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-3n.11 proposed a v2 path codec that the epic deferred under ADJ-9; recording it so it is built when a real note needs it.
